definitions.explanation: Dropping digits below a certain decimal place rather than rounding up. A mathematical and financial term.
Eliminating something deemed unnecessary or unwanted, sometimes ruthlessly.

examples.japanese: {小数点以下|しょうすうてんいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}てる。
examples.english: To round down the decimal places.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一円未満|いちえんみまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In sales tax calculations, amounts less than one yen are rounded down.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{表計算|ひょうけいさん}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{切|き}り{捨|す}て・⟦{切|き}り{上|あ}げ→切り上げ：24460_kiriage⟧・⟦{四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}→四捨五入：15694_shishagonyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}べる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: In this spreadsheet software, you can choose between rounding down, rounding up, or standard rounding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弱者|じゃくしゃ}→弱者：12535_jakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
{不採算|ふさいさん}⟦{部門|ぶもん}→部門：14406_bumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: They are considering cutting unprofitable divisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The policy is criticized as leading to the abandonment of rural areas.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {切|き}り{捨|す}てる (to cut off and discard). Has both a technical mathematical meaning and a figurative meaning of ruthlessly discarding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to round down; to discard
- {小数点以下|しょうすうてんいか}{切|き}り{捨|す}て: truncation below the decimal point
- ⟦{弱者|じゃくしゃ}→弱者：12535_jakusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{捨|す}て: abandoning the weak

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}り{上|あ}げ→切り上げ：24460_kiriage⟧: rounding up — the opposite operation
- ⟦{四捨五入|ししゃごにゅう}→四捨五入：15694_shishagonyuu⟧: standard rounding (round 4 and below down, 5 and above up)

ETYMOLOGY:
{切|き}り{捨|す}て⟦{御免|ごめん}→御免：00072_gomen⟧ was the historical right of samurai to kill commoners who showed disrespect, literally "cut down and pardon."
